claim: *Heterogeneous models over shared identities.* An engineering question selects a path through the available representations. The highlighted traversal follows a service from its registry entry through deployment topology to performance measurements, using shared identities to connect the models. Other models remain available for different questions.

topology.description: Author-requested service-performance traversal. Seven representations remain around a shared-identity ellipse. A heavy numbered path goes Service registry → hub → Deployment topology → hub → Measurements. Separate outward and return curves at deployment preserve the explicit shared-identity join; no deployment-to-measurement bypass exists. Thin spokes retain the four other available representations. Selected-path model names are bold; the performance question is italic. Omit the prior footer and the reference bottom legend as requested. All labels use 10pt house type.
